title: post api products compare with valid url
description: Test POST /api/products/compare endpoint with a valid Amazon or Flipkart product URL to verify it returns a 200 response containing accurate comparison results including extracted product details and matched marketplace listings.

title: post api products compare with no comparable matches
description: Test POST /api/products/compare endpoint with a valid product URL that has no comparable matches to verify it returns a 200 response indicating limited or no matches found with an informative message.

title: post api products compare with malformed url
description: Test POST /api/products/compare endpoint with a malformed or unsupported product URL to verify it returns a 400 validation error with a meaningful error message explaining the URL could not be processed.

title: post api products analyze with valid url
description: Test POST /api/products/analyze endpoint with a valid marketplace product URL to verify it returns a 200 response containing extracted product metadata including name, brand, model, price, category, source, and URL.

title: post api products analyze with unsupported or invalid url
description: Test POST /api/products/analyze endpoint with a URL from an unsupported website or invalid format to verify it returns a 400 validation error with an error message indicating the URL is unsupported or malformed.

title: get api products discover with valid keyword
description: Test GET /api/products/discover endpoint with a valid keyword query parameter to verify it returns a 200 response containing a list of candidate Amazon and Flipkart products for matching and comparison.

title: get api products discover with invalid or missing keyword
description: Test GET /api/products/discover endpoint with an empty, missing, or invalid keyword parameter to verify it returns an error response indicating invalid input or discovery failure with a meaningful error message.
